selection: Retain every accepted M2 instance. Promote only source crowns with safe stems and branches. Smooth source-sample selection from 45 to 60 metres; smooth pilot boundary over 400 metres. All unselected crowns retain grounded M2-style distant support.
shared_library: Six accepted M2 textured forms and four authored LODs. Deterministic individual yaw. No new whole-park near-detail layer.
source_limits: 2022 measured crown centres and heights; inferred stems and species forms. This is not a current forest survey.
